name: playtranslate
description: Real-time game translation app for Android for both language learners and casual gamers
readme_summary: PlayTranslate is an Android application that provides real-time translation for games, enabling users to understand game text in various languages. It supports features like one-tap translation, automatic translation, word lookup, offline capabilities, and integration with learning tools like Anki and Yomitan.
primary_use_case: Real-time in-game text translation for Android devices, aiding both language learners and casual gamers.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant 3D isometric illustration of a magical, floating game controller. From the controller, streams of colorful, glowing Japanese kanji characters are being instantly transformed into clear, readable English text bubbles that float around it. A small, stylized Android device is subtly integrated into the controller's design, displaying the translated text. The background is a soft, gradient blend of blues and purples, with subtle digital particles suggesting data flow. The overall mood is one of effortless understanding and accessibility, with the repository name 'PlayTranslate' subtly etched onto the controller. The scene emphasizes the seamless bridge between foreign game text and user comprehension.

name: batear
description: ● batear — Ultra-low-cost, off-grid acoustic drone detector. Edge computing. Protect your airspace with a microphone.
readme_summary: Batear is an ultra-low-cost, edge-only acoustic drone detector built on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller. It uses a microphone to detect drone rotor harmonics and can alert users via encrypted LoRa or wired Ethernet/PoE, integrating with smart home systems like Home Assistant.
key_features: Encrypted LoRa or wired Ethernet/PoE alerting
Web flasher for easy firmware updates
Selectable build configurations (Detector, Gateway, Wired Detector)
primary_use_case: To provide an affordable and accessible solution for detecting nearby drones using acoustic analysis, primarily for personal or community airspace security.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant, stylized owl perched on a fence post, its large, glowing eyes scanning the night sky. From its beak, sound waves emanate, subtly forming the shape of a drone silhouette. Below, a small, unobtrusive device with a glowing LED is visible on the fence post, representing the Batear hardware. In the background, a peaceful, dimly lit suburban house is protected. The overall mood is one of quiet vigilance and early warning. The image should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a dark, atmospheric color palette, with the repository name 'Batear' subtly integrated into the device's casing.

name: trippy
readme_summary: Trippy is a network diagnostic tool written in Rust that combines the functionalities of ping and traceroute. It provides real-time network performance analysis and helps users identify and troubleshoot network issues through an interactive terminal user interface.
key_features: Multiple installation methods (cargo, package managers, binaries)
primary_use_case: Diagnosing and analyzing network connectivity issues through an interactive terminal interface.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old cartographer meticulously drawing a complex network map on an ancient scroll. Instead of ink, they use glowing streams of data flowing from a modern laptop displaying the 'Trippy' interface. The map shows interconnected nodes, with some paths highlighted in red (indicating issues) and others in green (indicating smooth connections). Small, stylized icons of packets are shown traveling along these paths. The overall mood is one of focused investigation and clarity, with subtle digital particles emanating from the data streams. The style should be a detailed digital painting with a slightly mystical, yet technical feel, emphasizing the journey of data.

name: robin
readme_summary: Robin is an AI-powered Python tool designed for dark web Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) investigations. It utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance search queries, filter results from dark web search engines, and generate concise investigation summaries, offering a conversational interface for follow-up questions.
key_features: Multi-Model LLM Support (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, etc.)
primary_use_case: Conducting AI-assisted open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations on the dark web.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, intelligent owl wearing a detective's trench coat, perched on a glowing, abstract representation of the dark web (represented by interconnected, shadowy nodes). The owl is holding a magnifying glass that illuminates a specific, highlighted node, symbolizing focused investigation. Subtle digital particles and faint lines of code emanate from the owl's eyes, indicating AI processing. The background is a deep, muted blue with soft, ethereal light, suggesting mystery and depth. The overall mood is one of focused intelligence and discovery. The repository name 'Robin' is subtly integrated into the owl's badge. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic.

name: LiveAvatar
description: [ECCV 2026 Oral] Implementation of "Live Avatar: Streaming Real-time Audio-Driven Avatar Generation with Infinite Length"
readme_summary: Live Avatar is a framework for generating real-time, streaming, and infinitely long audio-driven avatar videos. It utilizes a large diffusion model and block-wise autoregressive processing to achieve high frame rates and support extended video generation.
key_features: High generalization performance across diverse characters and scenarios
primary_use_case: Real-time generation of long, interactive avatar videos driven by audio input.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor standing before a grand orchestra, with their hands shaping sound waves into a vibrant, animated avatar that is projected onto a large screen. The conductor's gestures directly influence the avatar's expressions and movements, which are synchronized with the music. Subtle digital particles representing audio data flow from the orchestra to the conductor, and then to the avatar. The background is a modern, minimalist stage with soft, dynamic lighting. The repository name 'Live Avatar' is subtly integrated into the stage design. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with clean lines and a focus on the flow of energy from sound to avatar.

name: liam
description: Automatically generates beautiful and easy-to-read ER diagrams from your database.
readme_summary: Liam ERD is an open-source tool that automatically generates beautiful, interactive Entity Relationship (ER) diagrams from your database schemas. It offers a seamless reverse-engineering process with zero configuration, providing high performance for projects of all sizes and an intuitive user interface for easy schema visualization.
key_features: Generates beautiful and interactive ER diagrams
Seamless reverse engineering from existing database schemas
primary_use_case: Visualizing database schemas through automatically generated ER diagrams.
cover_image_prompt: A master cartographer in a dimly lit, ancient library, using a magical quill to draw intricate maps. Instead of landmasses, the quill draws interconnected lines and nodes representing database tables and their relationships, pulled from a glowing, open book on the table. Small, ethereal data streams flow from the book to the quill. The resulting map is a beautiful, glowing ER diagram projected in the air above the table. The scene is rendered in a detailed digital painting style with a focus on the magical transformation of raw data into a clear, visual structure, with subtle UI elements of the Liam ERD interface visible on a nearby scroll.
